content: अवतानः .²1 Stretching of a bow. .²2 The unbending of a bow. .²3 A downward face. .²4 The spreading of a plant; लताशतैरवततामवतानशतैस्तथा <ls>Rām.</ls> .²5 A cover (in general); an awning; <ls>Mb. 2. 9. 3</ls>. .²6 <ab>N.</ab> of the verses; <ls>Vāj. 14. 56-63</ls>. .²7 Tendril; लतावतानावतः (महाद्रुमः) <ls>Mb. 3. 24. 26</ls>.
